title: fp.config.json
description: Configuration for a system that adopts the Lyrikai Fibonacci Protocol for UI/UX Design Agents, version 1.0.0-rc.4. MIT License. https://www.lyrikai.com . Defined by rule FP-MODE-02 in spec/02-integration-modes.md.

fp.description: The version string of the specification the system was checked against, in full.

level.description: Version 1.0 allows FP-1 and FP-2 only (FP-CONF-05).

platform.description: Version 1.0 allows web only (FP-CONF-05). ios, macos and android are reserved for 1.1.

pointerReason.description: Required when pointer is fine: why no touch or coarse pointer is supported.

has.description: What is inside the scope. Decides which rules are n/a (FP-CONF-11). A checker fails a false value for motion or controls that the source contradicts.

motion.description: Anything moves, blinks, scrolls or transitions.

timeLimits.description: Anything is removed or changed after a set time without the user asking.

generatedArt.description: Art made by a generator is shipped.

states.description: Status or state indicators are shown.

body.description: Body size in platform units. Default: the platform anchor (16 on the web).

source.description: File globs for everything the product ships that holds lengths.

scope.description: File globs the claim covers. Default: the same as source.

themes.description: Every theme the product ships. Every pair is tested in every theme. Default: one unnamed theme read from :root.

selector.description: The selector under which this theme's colour values are set, for example [data-theme="dark"].

media.description: The media query under which this theme's colour values are set, for example (prefers-color-scheme: dark).

files.description: The files that hold this theme's colour values.

pairs.description: Every foreground and background pair in use in the scope (FP-A11Y-01, FP-A11Y-20).

roles.description: Roles given to tokens, in every mode (FP-MODE-10).

controls.description: Class selectors of interactive elements that are not interactive by element name or ARIA role (FP-SNAP-11).

source.description: File globs for the files that hold the host's tokens now. Required in Snap.

table.description: Path of the published Snap table (FP-SNAP-08).

to.description: A rung of the declared unit, or a value of the radius set. Checked per unit below.

value.description: The value as written, with its unit.

where.description: A file and line, a selector, or a token address. A token address covers every use of that token.

rule.description: The rule the value departs from.

source.description: Where the data comes from. Required when reason is data.

tokenAddress.description: A CSS custom property name starting with --, or a dotted path in a tokens file.

tokenMatch.description: A token address in which * matches any run of characters.

colourRef.description: A token address, or a hex colour.

rungsU1.description: The ladder at u = 1 (which contains the radius set).

rungsU4.description: The ladder at u = 4, the sub-unit values, the fixed container widths and the radius set.

rungsU8.description: The ladder at u = 8, the sub-unit values, the fixed container widths and the radius set.
